texts.text: BSI-DSZ-CC-1188-2023-RA-02 TCOS ID Version 3.0 Release 1/P71 from Deutsche Telekom Security GmbH

texts.label: text
texts.text: SOGIS Recognition Agreement

texts.label: text
texts.text: The IT product identified in this report certified under the certification procedure BSI-DSZ-CC-1188-2023 [6] has undergone a reassessment of the vulnerability analysis according to the current state of the art attack methods according to the procedures on Assurance Continuity [5], based on the Security Target [7].

texts.label: text
texts.text: This reassessment confirms resistance of the product against attacks on the level of AVA_VAN.5 as stated in the product certificate.

texts.label: text
texts.text: More details are outlined on the following pages of this report.

texts.label: text
texts.text: This report is an addendum to the Certification Report BSI-DSZ-CC-11882023.

texts.label: text

texts.label: section_header
texts.text: Assessment

texts.label: text
texts.text: The   reassessment   was   performed   based   on   CC   [1],   CEM   [2],  according   to   the procedures on Assurance Continuity [5] and relevant AIS [4] and according to the BSI Certification Procedures [3] by the IT Security Evaluation Facility (ITSEF) SRC Security Research & Consulting GmbH, approved by BSI.

texts.label: text
texts.text: The following guidance specific for the technology has been applied as a refinement of CC and CEM:

texts.label: list_item
texts.text: Composite product evaluation for Smart Cards and similar devices according to AIS 36 (see [4]). On base of this concept the relevant guidance documents of the underlying IC platform (refer to [9]) and the document ETR for composite evaluation from the IC's evaluation ([11]) have been applied in the TOE evaluation.

texts.label: list_item
texts.text: Guidance for Smartcard Evaluation (AIS 37, see [4]).

texts.label: list_item
texts.text: Attack Methods for Smartcards and Similar Devices, under consideration of the current versions of the JIWG/JHAS documents 'Attack Methods for Smartcards and Similar Devices', Version 2.5 and 'Application of Attack Potential to Smartcards and Similar Devices', Version 3.2.1 (AIS 26, see [4]).

texts.label: list_item
texts.text: Application of CC to Integrated Circuits (AIS 25, see [4]).

texts.label: list_item
texts.text: Security Architecture requirements (ADV_ARC) for smart cards and similar devices (AIS 25, see [4]).

texts.label: list_item
texts.text: Evaluation Methodology for CC Assurance Classes for EAL5+ and EAL6 (AIS 34, see [4]).

texts.label: list_item
texts.text: Functionality classes and evaluation methodology of physical and deterministic random number generators (AIS 20 and AIS 31, see [4]).

texts.label: list_item
texts.text: Informationen zur Evaluierung von kryptographischen Algorithmen (AIS 46, see [4]).

texts.label: text
texts.text: The results of the reassessment of the product TCOS ID Version 3.0 Release 1/P71 are documented in an updated version of the ETR [8].

texts.label: text
texts.text: Please note that the product TCOS ID Version 3.0 Release 1/P71 is set up on the NXP Secure Smart Card Controller N7122 that was originally certified under the Certification ID   BSI-DSZ-CC-1149-2022   and   BSI-DSZ-CC-1149-2022-MA-01   (refer   to  BSI-DSZCC-1188-2023  [6]).   In   the   meantime,   the   IC   platform   was   re-certified   under   the Certification ID BSI-DSZ-CC-1149-V4-2025 (refer to [9]). For the present reassessment of the TOE, the corresponding updated ETR for composite evaluation [11] and IC user guidance documentation as referenced in [9] were taken into account.

texts.label: text
texts.text: This reassessment is the second reassessment of the product certified under BSI-DSZCC-1188-2023.   For   the   first   reassessment   refer   to  BSI-DSZ-CC-1188-2023-RA-01 (Assurance Continuity Reassessment Report [6]).

texts.label: section_header
texts.text: Regarding cryptographic security functionality:

texts.label: text
texts.text: Cryptographic   security   functionality   as   well   is   considered   within   the   scope   of   a reassessment.

texts.label: text
texts.text: No   changes   applied   regarding   cryptographic   security   functionality.   The   previous certification report and assurance continuity reassessment report [6] still apply in that regard.

texts.label: section_header
texts.text: Regarding assurance class life cycle (ALC):

texts.label: text
texts.text: The assurance class ALC as well is considered within the scope of a reassessment.

texts.label: text
texts.text: The  following   ALC   aspect   with   regard   to   the   conducted   vulnerability   assessment changed, compared to the previous certification and the subsequent first reassessment:

texts.label: list_item
texts.text: Movement of the development site Deutsche Telekom Security GmbH, Untere Industriestraße 20, 57250 Netphen-Dreis-Tiefenbach to the new development site Deutsche Telekom Security GmbH, Koblenzer Straße 87-93, 57072 Siegen

texts.label: text
texts.text: However, the development of the TOE was performed and finished at the former development site of Deutsche Telekom Security GmbH (refer to  BSI-DSZ-CC-11882023 [6]).

texts.label: text
texts.text: The renewal of the site certificate for Bundesdruckerei GmbH [12] has already been considered in the framework of the first reassessment.

texts.label: text
texts.text: Changes of ALC related aspects concerning the underlying NXP IC platform are covered by [9].

texts.label: section_header
texts.text: Conclusion

texts.label: text
texts.text: This reassessment confirms resistance of the product against attacks on the level AVA_VAN.5 as claimed in the Security Target [7].

texts.label: text
texts.text: The obligations and recommendations as outlined in the certification report [6] are still valid and have to be considered.

texts.label: text
texts.text: The obligations   and   recommendations   as   outlined   in   the   guidance   documentation referenced in [6] have to be considered by the user of the product.

texts.label: text
texts.text: The   assessment   on   TOE   cryptographic   security   functionality   did   not   change   in comparison to the previous certification [6].
